name: FinrankQuotientMap.span_eq_top
statement: p ≠ ⊤) (b : Set S) (hb' : Submodule.span R b ⊔ (p.map (algebraMap R S)).restrictScalars R = ⊤) : Submodule.span K (algebraMap S L '' b) = ⊤

name: FinrankQuotientMap.linearIndependent_of_nontrivial
statement: RingHom.ker (algebraMap R S) ≠ ⊤) (F : V'' →ₗ[R] V) (hf : Function.Injective F) (f' : V'' →ₗ[R] V') {ι : Type*} {b : ι → V''} (hb' : LinearIndependent S (f' ∘ b)) : LinearIndependent K (F ∘ b)

name: finrank_quotient_map
statement: p.IsMaximal] [Module.Finite R S] : finrank (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ map (algebraMap R S) p) = finrank K L

name: quotientToQuotientRangePowQuotSucc_surjective
statement: P ≠ ⊥) [hP : P.IsPrime] {i : ℕ} (hi : i < e) {a : S} (a_mem : a ∈ P ^ i) (a_notMem : a ∉ P ^ (i + 1)) : Function.Surjective (quotientToQuotientRangePowQuotSucc p P a_mem)

name: rank_prime_pow_ramificationIdx
statement: P ≠ ⊥) (he : e ≠ 0) : Module.rank (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ P ^ e) = e • @Module.rank (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ P) _ _ (@Algebra.toModule _ _ _ _ <| @Quotient.algebraQuotientOfRamificationIdxNeZero _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ⟨he⟩)

name: finrank_prime_pow_ramificationIdx
statement: P ≠ ⊥) [p.IsMaximal] [P.IsPrime] (he : e ≠ 0) : finrank (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ P ^ e) = e * @finrank (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ P) _ _ (@Algebra.toModule _ _ _ _ <| @Quotient.algebraQuotientOfRamificationIdxNeZero _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ⟨he⟩)

name: inertiaDeg_le_finrank
statement: Ideal R} [p.IsMaximal] (P : Ideal S) [hP₁ : P.IsPrime] [hP₂ : P.LiesOver p] (hp0 : p ≠ ⊥) : p.inertiaDeg P ≤ Module.finrank K L

name: ramificationIdx_le_finrank
statement: Ideal R} [p.IsMaximal] (P : Ideal S) [hP₁ : P.IsPrime] [hP₂ : P.LiesOver p] : p.ramificationIdx P ≤ Module.finrank K L

name: card_primesOverFinset_le_finrank
statement: Ideal R} [p.IsMaximal] (hp0 : p ≠ ⊥) : Finset.card (IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset p S) ≤ Module.finrank K L

name: ramificationIdx_mul_inertiaDeg_of_isLocalRing
statement: Ideal R} [p.IsMaximal] (hp0 : p ≠ ⊥) : ramificationIdx p (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) * p.inertiaDeg (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) = Module.finrank K L
